steps.title: 1. Primary locator succeeds directly without healing
2. Primary locator fails and initiates healing fallback
4. Second fallback succeeds when first fallback fails
5. All fallbacks fail and preserves genuine error
6. Multiple matching elements without context fails safely
7. Context-based healing accurately scopes to intended card
8. Click healing handles broken selector and triggers event
9. Input healing recovers and fills value
10. Visibility healing verifies element through fallback
11. Disabled element is rejected during interactive action healing
12. Hidden element is rejected during interactive click healing
13. Timeout is enforced properly without infinite hanging
14. Invalid locator syntax is handled gracefully without crashing system
15. Healing disabled obeys configuration and fails immediately
16. Previously healed locator is prioritized from history
18. CI execution generates valid JSON and HTML reports
